title: Spark
description: Ask Spark about stock and sales. In this demo its answers are scripted.
restore: Restore Spark to its side panel

empty.title: Ask about stock or sales
empty.intro: Spark reads the item list and the sales history, then answers with the figures and where they come from. It drafts; a person decides and sends.
empty.stock: How many HP monitors do we have?
empty.trend: How have sales moved over the last 12 months?

note: Demo: scripted answers from the synthetic data. No AI model is connected.

input.label: Ask Spark
input.help: Enter sends. Shift and Enter start a new line.

draft.title: Draft a reply to the customer
draft.subject: Stock of {{description}}
draft.due: A further {{due}} are due on purchase orders.
draft.body:
Hello,

Thank you for asking about the {{description}} ({{part}}). {{stock}} We can confirm a shipping date as soon as we receive your purchase order.

Kind regards,
Spectra Innovations
draft.note: Spark drafts the reply. A person reads it, changes it and sends it from their own mail. Nothing is sent from this preview.
